links.outcome: Tumor size measurement agreement of CDSS versus radiologists against pathologic size
links.effect: CDSS and radiology reports both showed ICC 0.869 with pathology; no significant difference between radiologists and CDSS; CDSS detected 162/176 (92%) tumors; interobserver ICC 0.907 vs CDSS 1.000
links.quote: No significant differences were found in the measurement of tumor size between radiologists and the CDSS.

screen.reason: Multicenter retrospective reader study evaluating the diagnostic accuracy and reproducibility of a commercial deep learning CDSS for lung nodule size measurement compared to radiologists and pathology.
